name: Aníbal Quijano
shortBio: Peruvian sociologist and social theorist whose formulation of the 'coloniality of power' reshaped contemporary sociology, world-systems theory, and global decolonial philosophy.
centralQuestion: How does the racialized hierarchy born out of the conquest of the Americas continue to structure global capitalism, knowledge, and subjectivity?

keyWorks.title: Coloniality of Power, Eurocentrism, and Latin America
keyWorks.description: Foundational essay outlining coloniality as the fundamental organizing axis of world capitalism, racial division of labor, and epistemological hegemony.

keyWorks.title: Coloniality and Modernity/Rationality
keyWorks.description: Critique of Eurocentric rationality as an epistemology that conceals colonial domination by projecting itself as universal and timeless.
